job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: This is SBCERS’s RFP for global custody and related services, not LAFPP’s RFP for financial statement audit services. It does not support the specified three-year audit contract or two optional one-year renewals.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System (“SBCERS”)

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, and other services to SBCERS as defined in this RFP.
